items.title: Joe Muranyi interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: a part of that scene was Bob Wilber. That’s where I first met Bob Wilber.

ctx.x: They’re on 57th if they’re still around. But I rehearsed there with Louis Armstrong. So anyhow the Nola’s Studio, you could rent. You could rent a room, it had a piano, and the deal was everybody would kick in some money, two, three dollars, whatever it was, and rent a room for an hour or two hours, and have a jam session. And we did that. And there
was, you know, really feeling our way and a part of that scene was Bob Wilber. That’s where I first met Bob Wilber. Bob Wilber, by the way, looks much better today than he did then. He was a skinny —
